assertion.statement: For the quotient A_f in Theorem1, the pullback of invariant differentials is the span of the conjugate eigenforms; for rational coefficient field it is the line C f(z)dz.
assertion.objects: Normalized common eigenform f, its coefficient field K, Jacobian J and quotient A_f.
assertion.hypotheses: Theorem1 common Hecke eigenform hypotheses and its constructed quotient; K=Q for the one-dimensional specialization.
assertion.quantifiers: Every quotient and eigenform satisfying the cited theorem.
assertion.parameter_range: Weight two; the quotient dimension equals [K:Q].
assertion.uniformity: The same quotient and differential subspace throughout.
assertion.constants: No period or Manin constant is specified.
assertion.normalizations: The theorem identifies differential pullback via the modular curve/Jacobian identification.
assertion.exceptional_cases: No action of an extra involution is asserted here.
assertion.limit_order: Construct the eigenquotient before comparing the action of W on its differential line.

use.reason: The primitive Shimura differential-line input is consumed by the actual quotient comparison, separately from Atkin-Lehner eigen-action.

adverse_cases.reason: For pi obtained by composition with a nonzero characteristic-zero isogeny, pullback of a nonzero invariant differential is nonzero, so only its scalar changes. This input neither supplies W eigen-action nor the cuspidal annihilator.
